title: Surrozen Announces Pricing of $60 Million Underwritten Offering of Common Stock

November 13, 2026 08:00 ET


SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., Nov. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Surrozen, Inc. (“Surrozen” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: SRZN), a biotechnology company pioneering targeted therapeutics to harness the power of Wnt signaling to address the underlying drivers of disease in sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions, today announced the pricing of an underwritten offering of 1,894,540 shares of its common stock at an offering price of $31.67 per share. The gross proceeds to Surrozen from the offering, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and offering expenses payable by Surrozen, are expected to be $60 million. All the shares in the offering are being sold by Surrozen. The offering is expected to close on or about November 16, 2026, subject to the satisfaction of customary closing conditions.


The offering includes participation from Access Biotechnology, Boxer Capital Management, Perceptive Advisors, RTW Investments, Venrock Healthcare Capital Partners, and other new and existing life sciences focused investors.


Morgan Stanley, Guggenheim Securities and Cantor are acting as joint book-running managers for the offering.


The offering is being made pursuant to a shelf registration statement on Form S-3 (File No. 333-294542) that was previously filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) on March 23, 2026 and was declared effective by the SEC on March 30, 2026. This offering is being made only by means of a prospectus supplement to be filed with the SEC and an accompanying prospectus that form a part of the effective registration statement. When available, copies of the prospectus supplement and the accompanying prospectus may also be obtained by contacting: Morgan Stanley & Co. **About Surrozen**
Surrozen is a biotechnology company, pioneering a new class of Wnt-based therapeutics designed to harness the power of Wnt signaling to treat sight-threatening ophthalmic conditions. Built on deep scientific expertise and a proprietary antibody-engineering platform, Surrozen develops multifunctional biologics that selectively activate Wnt signaling in combination with other key disease pathways. Our approach aims to deliver best-in-class, durable therapies that have the potential to transform patient outcomes in some of the most pressing unmet medical needs in ocular diseases.
